purpose: Fail-closed no-GT audit of whether every persistent V9 current-node frontier target ends in its exact matching verified departure, a different verified departure, or a loop merge back to the same node. V1 was superseded unexecuted because it did not validate all trace identities, exact traversals or create_run provenance.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only V1R audit of all 30 V9 traces and snapshots in the exact finalized 90-case source; no simulation, bag read, GT/map read, training, model selection, threshold tuning or source mutation.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope; V1R only strengthens evidence identity and remains conditional on exact finalized source binding.

sampling.independent_analysis_unit: one V9 closed-loop case within the frozen world-by-environment-seed block design

method.identity_validation: Validate every row's frame, route arc, graph-update identity, current node, target mode/path and final append-only stub index. Bind the exact source causal-graph implementation hash.
method.verified_transition: Require every inter-node decision transition to have exactly one source-to-destination verified traversal with the same end frame and route arc before replaying the exact departure-stub geometry rule.
method.persistence: Report contiguous target frames and route-arc distance. Aggregate only against each case's frozen waypoint lookahead and minimum graph-event travel, with no new selected threshold.
method.run_identity: Require the exact standard Gate-6 run directory and create_run snapshots of spec, card, command, RUN_STATE, environment and project status.

failure_policy: Fail on source state/status/count/seal/schedule/causal-graph drift; invalid frame, arc, node, stub, path, edge or traversal; inconsistent event aggregates; nonstandard run provenance; source write, bag/GT/map read, training, parameter selection or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: 90-case source provenance and manifest with 60 verified V9 trace/snapshot hashes
30 per-case V1R frontier-attempt audits with exact verified traversal evidence and target persistence
recomputed aggregate outcomes at only the two frozen planner distance scales

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; zero Gazebo, ROS, GPU, training or raw bag decompression.
